notes.title: 1.1 Major Game Update - Sweet Holiday Jigsaws: Halloween Night
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39580520/96155883badb53d3ab2ade8fb50a14296f1460e0.jpg[/img]

Enjoy this update in the most wonderful time of the year. Happy Halloween!
